Hi! I’m Kenneth 👋

I’m a software engineer based in Hong Kong. Growing up, I always had a knack for figuring out how things work. Playing a video game by following the intended path was never that interesting to me; instead, I loved messing with the mechanics, searching for exploits and shortcuts. The satisfaction of putting together something that breaks the system—something not even the developer had thought of—is what first sparked my passion for problem-solving.

That curiosity naturally translated into a career in computer science, where I get to build creative solutions to complex problems, much like I did in those video games. I chose to apply this passion in the field of finance because when technology meets finance, it becomes infrastructure that empowers millions of people around the world. Knowing that the code I write can make a tangible improvement in people’s lives is incredibly exciting to me, and it’s what drives me to keep learning and growing as a software engineer.

Life is short—do what matters, appreciate the journey and the people in it, and have fun along the way.
